assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and underlying sick sinus syndrome.
The symptoms are intermittent in nature.
There is a need to correlate clinical events with rhythm disturbances.
A 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring study is ordered to evaluate for arrhythmia burden and sinus node dysfunction.
The service is medically necessary to evaluate for arrhythmia burden and sinus node dysfunction.
The service is directly indicated for the documented symptoms and suspected diagnosis.
The service supports correlating the patient's intermittent clinical events with underlying rhythm disturbances.
The clinical events include paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and sick sinus syndrome.
The clinical indication note reflects the clinical indication.
The CPT code for the 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring study is 93226.
The service is a 48-hour Holter monitoring study.
